text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Um, 'Thank you so much for everything
this past year!' And, and then..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"...I forgot!
Ehehe~."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, congrats!
Looking forward to working with you this year too!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
So, what are we doing today again?
choice_data_list: Have you decided on your aspirations?
Did you decide on your aspirations?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Hope?
Wait, what was that again?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hofu, hofu... hofu hofu, tofu!
I get it, it's something delicious!
choice_data_list: You can consider it your goal for this year.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: A goal?! In that case, I've definitely got one!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"‘Run a lot, and win 1st place a lot!’
How's that?!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, right, right?
It's what you'd call "Jiggle is Bento"!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly that!
Didn't I tell you?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And hey, running lots of races is easy enough,
but winning 1st place in all of them is super tough, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So I'm gonna let Trainer figure out what to do!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm in charge of running, and you're in charge of 1st place!
Ehehe, what do you think?

In order to make Haru Urara's goal come true,
what I need to do right now is...
choice_data_list: Let's overcome our weaknesses through sheer willpower!
Let's get plenty of sleep so you can grow!
Let's acquire your very own special move!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~?
What does "bad at" mean?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh~!?
Why do we have to study~ !?

No matter how you look at it, not being able to say
"Simple is best" is bad. As a Trainer responsible
for students, I can't just overlook this...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Fighting spirit...! Is fighting spirit really that amazing?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Is it so amazing that
you won't have any weaknesses left...!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Then, then, could it be...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If I've got enough fighting spirit,
can I get good at anything~?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I'll listen to whatever you say, Trainer!
I'm gonna get super, super pumped up~!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mun!
Motivation, motivation, gather in my tummy~!

Haru Urara tackled her studies with pure spirit,
but whether she managed to absorb anything other than
'fighting spirit' in the end... is anyone's guess.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mumu, you're going to sleep?
I always get plenty of sleep, you know?
choice_data_list: Then let's sleep even more than usual!

text_block_list.text:
It's the New Year. First, let's get plenty of rest
and set the stage for a healthy year ahead.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mm! I get it!
It's a battle against myself, right!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
I'm going to fight the me I've been up until now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna sleep way, waay more than before!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*.

After that, Haru Urara took a solid nap
and gave her body a good, relaxing rest.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
My very own...!
Special move...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
S-S-So cool~!
I want a special move of my own!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right!
Um, you see, um...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Haru Urara loves carrots!"
"Haru Urara wants first place!" ...Like that!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Right? It's so cool, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer!
What's your ultimate secret move!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Since you're a Trainer,
I'm sure you have an insanely cool one!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, tell me!
I promise I won't tell anyone!

...After that, we spent until sundown
thinking up special moves with Haru Urara.
Surely, something good must have come out of it...
